traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points some- where in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The marilith has Advantage on sav- ing throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.text: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: Trigger: The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. Medusa Medusa
